elements.char: In this work we extend equation learning methods to be feasible for biological applications
elements.label: text

elements.char: with nonlinear dynamics and where data are often sparse and noisy. Physics-informed
elements.label: text

elements.char: neural networks have recently been shown to approximate solutions of PDEs from simu-
elements.label: text

elements.char: lated noisy data while simultaneously optimizing the PDE parameters. However, the suc-
elements.label: text

elements.label: text

elements.char: not be known in practice. Here, we present an extension of the algorithm that allows neu-
elements.label: text
